members.name: NoNegativeBalancesWithoutOverdraft
members.expr: forall id in accounts: balances[id] >= 0

members.name: PendingConsistent
members.expr: forall tid in inFlight: tid in pendingTransfers.keys

members.name: PrNeedsApproval
members.expr: stage != 5 or testsPassed

members.name: HoldOnJudge
members.expr: stage != 5 or prFromApproved

members.name: PrNeedsGreenTests
members.expr: stage != 5 or testsPassed

members.name: PrNeedsApproval
members.expr: stage != 5 or prFromApproved

members.name: DeployNeedsChecks
members.expr: stage != 4 or checksPassed

members.name: DeployNeedsApproval
members.expr: stage != 4 or deployFromApproved

members.name: ElectionSafety
members.expr: state == Leader -> currentTerm > 0

members.name: LeaderCompleteness
members.expr: commitIndex <= length(log)

members.name: LogMatching
members.expr: forall i in log.indices: i > 0 && i <= length(log) && log[i-1].term == log[i-1].term -> log[i-1].value == log[i-1].value

members.name: LeaderAppendOnly
members.expr: length(log') >= length(log)

members.name: TermMonotonicity
members.expr: currentTerm' >= currentTerm

members.name: CommitSafety
members.expr: commitIndex <= length(log)

members.name: NoTokenLeakage
members.expr: forall token in accessTokens.keys: let t := accessTokens[token] t.client_id in clients.keys and exists s in sessions.keys: sessions[s].user_id == t.user_id forall rt in refreshTokens.keys: let r := refreshTokens[rt] r.client_id in clients.keys forall code in authorizationCodes.keys: let c := authorizationCodes[code] c.client_id in clients.keys and c.redirect_uri in clients[c.client_id].redirect_uris

members.name: StateCSRFProtection
members.expr: forall state in stateNonces.keys: let n := stateNonces[state] n.client_id in clients.keys and n.redirect_uri in clients[n.client_id].redirect_uris forall code in authorizationCodes.keys: let c := authorizationCodes[code] c.state in stateNonces.keys

members.name: AuthorizationCodeSingleUse
members.expr: forall code in authorizationCodes.keys: let c := authorizationCodes[code] c.used == false implies not exists action in next: action.name == "ExchangeCode" and action.params.code == code

members.name: TokenValidityBounded
members.expr: forall token in accessTokens.keys: let t := accessTokens[token] t.expires_at > currentTime forall rt in refreshTokens.keys: let r := refreshTokens[rt] currentTime - r.created_at <= 7776000  // 90 days max

members.name: PKCECodeInterceptionPrevention
members.expr: forall challenge in pkceChallenges.keys: let c := pkceChallenges[challenge] exists verifier in authorizationCodes.keys: let a := authorizationCodes[verifier] a.code_challenge == challenge and a.code_challenge_method == c.method forall code in authorizationCodes.keys: let c := authorizationCodes[code] c.used == false implies pkceChallenges[c.code_challenge].code_verifier_hash == hash(c.code_verifier, c.code_challenge_method)

members.name: RedirectUriConsistency
members.expr: forall code in authorizationCodes.keys: let c := authorizationCodes[code] true  // This is enforced in the ExchangeCode action

members.name: ClientAuthenticationRequired
members.expr: forall code in authorizationCodes.keys: let c := authorizationCodes[code] c.client_id in clients.keys implies exists r in refreshTokens.keys: refreshTokens[r].client_id == c.client_id

members.name: BallotUniqueness
members.expr: forall b in ballots.keys: forall b2 in ballots.keys \ {b}: b.number != b2.number

members.name: SingleValuePerBallot
members.expr: forall b in ballots.keys: forall b2 in ballots.keys: b.number == b2.number implies ballots[b].value == ballots[b2].value

members.name: PaxosSafety
members.expr: forall b in chosen.keys: forall b2 in ballots.keys: b2.number == b.number implies ballots[b2].value == chosen[b]

members.name: ApplyFromApproved
members.expr: stage != 5 or appliedFromApproved

members.name: LiveNeedsFlow
members.expr: metadataLive implies (metadataDrafted and uploadsStarted)

members.name: SingleLeaderPerTerm
members.expr: forall s1 in servers: forall s2 in servers: serverState[s1].role == "leader" and serverState[s2].role == "leader" and s1 != s2 implies serverState[s1].currentTerm != serverState[s2].currentTerm

members.name: LeaderCompleteness
members.expr: forall s in servers: serverState[s].role == "leader" implies forall entry in serverState[s].log: entry.index <= serverState[s].commitIndex implies entry.term <= serverState[s].currentTerm

members.name: LogMatching
members.expr: forall s1 in servers: forall s2 in servers: forall i in [1 .. length(serverState[s1].log)]: i <= length(serverState[s2].log) and serverState[s1].log[i].term == serverState[s2].log[i].term implies serverState[s1].log[i].command == serverState[s2].log[i].command

members.name: MergeNeedsApproval
members.expr: stage < 4 or (approved and testsPassed)

members.name: CommitAtomicity
members.expr: dirtyPageCount >= 0

members.name: RollbackSafety
members.expr: dirtyPageCount == 0

members.name: JournalConsistency
members.expr: journalExists == true -> activeTransaction == true

members.name: PageCacheCoherence
members.expr: activeTransaction == true and dirtyPageCount > 0 -> pagerState != Idle

members.name: LockProgression
members.expr: currentLock != ""

members.name: ErrorRecovery
members.expr: errorState == true -> activeTransaction == false

members.name: AccountBalanceInvariant
members.expr: forall a in accounts.values: a.balance == a.credits_posted - a.debits_posted forall a in accounts.values: a.debits_pending >= 0 a.credits_pending >= 0

members.name: TransferStateConsistency
members.expr: forall t in transfers.values: t.pending implies t.posted == false && t.voided == false forall t in transfers.values: t.posted implies t.voided == false forall t in transfers.values: t.voided implies t.posted == false

members.name: NoOverdraft
members.expr: forall a in accounts.values: a.balance >= 0 or a.flags.allows_overdraft

members.name: SwitchConsistent
members.expr: isOn in {true, false}

members.name: TPTypeOK
members.expr: rmState.values subsetOf {"working", "prepared", "committed", "aborted"} tmState in {"init", "committed", "aborted"} tmPrepared subsetOf rms

members.name: TPConsistency
members.expr: tmState == "committed" implies forall rm in rms: rmState[rm] == "committed" tmState == "aborted" implies forall rm in rms: rmState[rm] == "aborted" forall rm in rms: rmState[rm] == "committed" implies tmState != "aborted" forall rm in rms: rmState[rm] == "prepared" implies tmState in {"init", "committed"}
